source.name: Alsulaiman Group – Flow Progressive Logistics Becomes the Latest Sponsor of Al-Ittihad Club Ahead of SPL Kickoff
source.quote: Flow Progressive Logistics, a subsidiary of Alsulaiman Group, announced today, Wednesday 21st of August, the signing of a sponsorship agreement with Al-Ittihad Saudi Club
source.note: The same announcement states the sponsorship runs for a three-year term.
